script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# This script will install LogSentry engine (docker mode)
# Replace placeholders below or generate a tailored script via /bootstrap
ENGINE_DSN="postgresql://logsentry:logsentry@<DB_HOST>:5432/logsentry"
LOGSENTRY_API_KEY="<SERVER_API_KEY>"
AUGUR_URL="<AUGUR_URL>"
AUGUR_API_KEY="<AUGUR_API_KEY>"
THREATPULSE_URL="<THREATPULSE_URL>"
THREATPULSE_API_KEY="<THREATPULSE_API_KEY>"

curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w01f/logsentry/main/deploy/install-docker.sh -o /tmp/logsentry-install-docker.sh
chmod +x /tmp/logsentry-install-docker.sh
/tmp/logsentry-install-docker.sh --db-dsn "$ENGINE_DSN" --api-key "$LOGSENTRY_API_KEY" \
  ${AUGUR_URL:+--augur-url "$AUGUR_URL"} ${AUGUR_API_KEY:+--augur-api-key "$AUGUR_API_KEY"} \
  ${THREATPULSE_URL:+--threatpulse-url "$THREATPULSE_URL"} ${THREATPULSE_API_KEY:+--threatpulse-api-key "$THREATPULSE_API_KEY"}
